method: per-criterion median across three judges, then weighted by the rubric

notes.problem: Wheel half a frame right of the figure, hand on the cushion, no windshield or road, grey door panel.
notes.fix: Passenger-seat camera at 1.9 m looking forward-left, wheel in front of the figure, hands on the rim, windshield open to road and seam.

notes.problem: Wheel at right with no one behind it, person beside it, no windshield road or seam, speckled panel, dek over busy geometry, stray vertical.
notes.fix: Passenger-seat camera aimed so the wheel stands in front of the torso with hands on the rim, windshield open, panel and vertical removed, dek on the dark headliner.

notes.problem: Hunched mannequin in the foreground, wheel unoccupied at right, reads as an empty driver's seat; mid-grey door panel.
notes.fix: Camera behind the passenger headrest looking forward-left so hands rest on the rim, crop above the jaw, key confined to the side glass.

notes.problem: Flat mid-grey slab, stair-stepped cast, banded dead bottom.
notes.fix: Low raking oblique so the rule fills the lower two thirds, key on the stop face and groove walls only, higher shadow resolution.

notes.problem: Flat mid-grey slab, stair-stepped cast, no hard start, brown groove, dead banded bottom third.
notes.fix: End the plate at a tall stop at the left edge, low raking key, higher shadow resolution, rule on its planned diagonal, true dusk_gold groove.

notes.problem: Flat mid-grey slab, stair-stepped cast, dead bottom mat with a jagged diagonal, brown groove.
notes.fix: Low raking key so only bevel and graduation walls catch light, smoother shadow, crop the mat, groove to the true accent.

notes.problem: ITE leader a stub on its own 7; other leaders end on dim cars.
notes.fix: Run each leader to its company's divider and light the far single car.

notes.problem: Pool on far rows, near Avride rows murky, leaders cross roofs, 7 collides with its dot, flat divider quads.
notes.fix: Pool on the near rows, a label column whose leaders don't cross roofs, dividers as worn thermoplastic bars.

notes.problem: Leaders fan and cross, ITE leader ends on nothing, end bars barely read over a muddy lot.
notes.fix: Pin each label at the end of its run without leaders, lift the camera so rows read as stepped rows, wider brighter end bars.

notes.problem: Floating block skyline with a sphere, blue-grey cars, empty bottom third.
notes.fix: Sink the skyline into the haze, delete the sphere, limestone paint, lower the camera to the tail rows.

notes.problem: Cool blue cars against the key, casts toward camera, block skyline with a sphere, packed lot, empty bottom.
notes.fix: Tail rows of single limestone cars under the -55 key casting right, camera lower, one hazed skyline silhouette.

notes.problem: Lone car on the stripe in front of full rows; empty bays faint.
notes.fix: Camera down the car's own row at 1.5 m so nine lit stops lead to the car, stripe out from under it.
